paragraphs: Bolstering Confidence and Jointly Overcoming Difficulties to Build a Better World* Xi Jinping President of the People’s Republic of China The United Nations (UN) should hold high the banner of true multilateralism and serve as the central platform for countries to jointly safeguard universal security, share development achievements and chart the course for the future of the world. The UN should stay committed to ensuring a stable international order, increasing the representation and say of developing countries in international affairs, and taking the lead in advancing democracy and rule of law in international relations. The UN should advance, in a balanced manner, work in all the three areas of security, development and human rights.
